image_description: A male black grouse (blackcock) in a dynamic display pose on grassy ground. The bird has glossy black plumage with visible iridescence, prominent red eyebrow combs, and white markings on the wings and undertail area. Its tail feathers are fanned out in a lyre shape, and wings are partially spread.
